visualCharacteristics.purpose: Related article cards at the end of an article
visualCharacteristics.layout: responsive grid, up to 4 across; landscape image, uppercase category link, title link

contentPattern.structure: one row per article; cell 1 is the image (optionally linked to the article), cell 2 holds a category link paragraph followed by a title link paragraph

usage: Related Articles section below the main article content.
reuseGuidance: Use for any list of linked article teasers. With one paragraph in the text cell it is treated as the title.
